name: Normal Furry
summary: The Normal Furry is the baseline melee threat that fills waves, pushes flags, and punishes isolated players.
role: Clear Normal Furries before they stack on a capture point. Individually they are manageable, but groups can contest territory and stall capture progress.
fun_facts: Normal Furries are the reference point for the larger variants: faster, tankier, ranged, or explosive enemies are built around this baseline pressure.

name: Pimple Furry
summary: The Pimple Furry is a slower, tougher explosive variant that detonates after death.
role: Drop Pimple Furries away from teammates and capture clusters. The body is still dangerous after the health bar is gone.
fun_facts: Pimple Furries use the shorter explosive respawn delay shared by the other detonation-style enemies.

name: Watcher Furry
summary: The Watcher Furry is a faster melee variant with more health than the baseline Furry.
role: Prioritize Watchers when they break through the front line. Their speed makes them better at reaching players who are reloading or holding a narrow angle.
fun_facts: Watcher Furries are faster than the baseline Normal Furry while carrying twice the health.

name: Bloater Furry
summary: The Bloater Furry is a heavy explosive enemy with high health and slow movement.
role: Kill Bloaters at range. Letting one die inside the team or on a capture point can turn a clean hold into a wipe.
fun_facts: Bloaters are the slowest regular Furry variant.

name: Leader Furry
summary: The Leader Furry is a high-health heavy variant that soaks far more damage than normal wave enemies.
role: Focus Leaders with sustained fire. They are not the fastest enemy, but their health lets them hold attention while other Furries close distance.
fun_facts: A Leader has thirty-five times the health of a Normal Furry.

name: Robot Furry
summary: The Robot Furry is a durable melee variant with a very short attack cooldown.
role: The Robot Furry's attack cadence is faster than the standard melee variants, so spacing matters.
fun_facts: Robot Furries have the fastest melee attack cooldown among the regular variants.

name: Spitter Furry
summary: The Spitter Furry is a ranged variant that attacks from distance instead of only relying on melee pressure.
role: Break line of sight or kill Spitters early. They punish players who only watch the immediate melee swarm.
fun_facts: Spitters prefer keeping distance instead of always trying to stand on top of the target.

name: Furry Helper
summary: Furry Helpers are small boss-area enemies that pressure the arena and explode when killed.
role: Clear Helpers before they crowd the boss space or punish players dealing with the core. Their damage is lower than regular melee pressure, but they complicate the fight.
fun_facts: Helpers can approach the boss arena from several routes, so the fight rarely stays quiet for long.

name: Furry Boss
summary: The Furry Boss is the Traditional endgame enemy unlocked after every reclaimable territory is held by defenders.
role: Treat the boss as the final team objective. Damage contribution matters, the core can affect sustain, and the fight scales with the number of active fighters.

stats.defeated_badge: Awarded to all players on boss defeat

fun_facts: The boss reward can roll higher multipliers for the top contributor.
Boss health and difficulty are recalculated during the fight based on active fighters.
